thread:
dmitri_cust: Hey team — customer reported SSO failures right after their IdP cert rollover last night. They see 403s on SAML response. Sample error from our logs: `InvalidRecipient` and `AssertionConsumerService unmatched`. Started ~2025-11-02T09:12:00Z.

alice_support: Thanks, Dmitri. Can you paste the exact ACS URL the SP is configured with and the IdP metadata URL they provided? Any recent changes to entityID casing or trailing slashes?

dmitri_cust: ACS in customer config: `https://app.example-corp.com/sso/acs` (no trailing slash). IdP metadata URL they gave: `https://idp.partnercorp.com/metadata.xml`. They said they rotated signing certs at 09:00 UTC.

alice_support: Two quick checks: 1) Is our cached IdP metadata still the old cert? 2) Does the IdP publish multiple <AssertionConsumerService> entries or a different entityID casing (e.g., EntityID vs entityid)?

ben_infra: I pulled our cached metadata for that IdP from the cache service: metadata last fetched 2025-11-01T08:45Z. The metadata in the CDN edge still has old cert fingerprint. Looks like our metadata poller missed the 09:00 rotation.

elaine_sre: Repro steps I used locally:
1. curl -sS https://idp.partnercorp.com/metadata.xml > idp.xml
2. xmllint --xpath 'string(//EntityDescriptor/@entityID)' idp.xml -> returns `https://idp.partnercorp.com/EntityID`
3. Check AssertionConsumerService list:
```
xmllint --xpath '//AssertionConsumerService' idp.xml
```
It contains two ACS endpoints, one with trailing slash (`/sso/acs/`) and one without. Our SP is configured without trailing slash.

dmitri_cust: Customer claims they didn't change ACS on their side. They did change IdP certs only. But they do have a newer metadata file where entityID is lowercase `https://idp.partnercorp.com/entityid` — differing only by case.

alice_support: That could explain it. Our SP strict comparison treats entityID as case-sensitive for some IdP implementations. If the metadata entityID casing differs from what the IdP signs the assertion with, we reject. Also if the IdP updated ACS ordering and our recipient selection picks the first matching ACS which has trailing slash, that can cause mismatch.

ben_infra: Immediate mitigation: force-refresh metadata for that IdP and invalidate CDN cache for the metadata endpoint. I can trigger a fetch and compare cert thumbprints.

deploybot: deploy status: metadata-refresher v2.3.1 triggered: job 8421 queued -> running (started 2025-11-02T09:20:12Z).

ben_infra: Pulled latest metadata. New cert fingerprint: `SHA256:AA:BB:CC:...:99`. Old fingerprint: `SHA256:11:22:33:...:88`. Also found entityID case discrepancy and dual ACS endpoints.

alice_support: For immediate customer-facing workaround, ask the IdP admin to either: 1) ensure the entityID in metadata and SAML responses match exactly (including case), or 2) add an ACS entry that exactly matches our SP ACS (`https://app.example-corp.com/sso/acs`). Also we can temporarily relax strict entityID case comparison on their account if they authorize it (note: security tradeoff).

dmitri_cust: Customer requested a quick fix — they pushed updated metadata with consistent entityID case and single ACS without trailing slash. They confirmed the IdP will sign with the new cert.

ben_infra: After forcing refresh and clearing metadata cache, I verified the metadata now has new cert and the entityID matches. I also ran a live auth attempt and saw SAML response accepted.

elaine_sre: Logs from the acceptance test: 
```
SAML validate: success, InResponseTo: abc-12345, Recipient: https://app.example-corp.com/sso/acs
Assertion signature: valid (thumbprint SHA256:AA:BB:CC...:99)
```

alice_support: Great. Marking this as resolved for now. Next steps: add more robust polling for metadata changes and a fast-path invalidation on detected cert rotations. Also add an alert when entityID casing changes or when multiple ACS endpoints include conflicting trailing slash usage.

dmitri_cust: Customer confirmed login flows recovered at 09:32 UTC. They want a post-mortem checklist.

ben_infra: I'll open a short ops ticket with actions: 
- Ensure metadata poller respects Cache-Control / max-age and also supports metadata push webhooks (if IdP supports).
- Add a TTL override for critical IdPs to force more frequent refreshes during rotations.
- Add diagnostics that print both metadata entityID and the entityID in signed assertions for easier triage.

alice_support: I'll send the customer the temporary relaxation option and recommended IdP config (exact entityID match + canonical ACS URL). Also include repro steps and the xmllint commands.

deploybot: ticket created: INFRA-2156 "metadata poller: detect and notify on cert rotation and entityID mismatch".

alice_support: I'll follow up with a short post-mortem and share with ENG/SEC. :thumbsup:

dmitri_cust: Thanks everyone, customer is happy.
